strategy: The robot will navigate towards the goal by prioritizing safe goal-ahead, then goal-left, then goal-right. If no goal is ahead, it will attempt to move forward if unblocked. If all directions are blocked, it will stop safely.

decisions.condition: goal_ahead is true and front_blocked is false
decisions.reason: The goal is ahead and the front is unblocked, so the robot should move forward.

decisions.condition: goal_on_left is true and left_blocked is false
decisions.reason: The goal is on the left and the left direction is unblocked, so the robot should turn left.

decisions.condition: goal_on_right is true and right_blocked is false
decisions.reason: The goal is on the right and the right direction is unblocked, so the robot should turn right.

decisions.condition: front_blocked is true and left_blocked is true and right_blocked is true
decisions.reason: All directions are blocked, so the robot must stop safely.

stop_condition: The robot must stop when all directions (front, left, right) are blocked to ensure safe navigation.
